title: 第11章 家人的信任提议围猎第12章 这个世界有武功
slug: 打猎娶妻加点我无敌了
lines: 林夜身轻如燕，在山林中奔跑穿梭。
不多时，就回到之前杀狼的地方。
獐子和狼尸都还在，他将狼和獐子放血，掏空内脏。
随后又在周围找了几根合适的树枝，用绳子绑成简易的拖着，架着战利品，原路返回。
回到上白村，已是傍晚，村里人很快就注意到他。
等他刚将猎物拖到家门口，人群都围了上来。
那三头狰狞的狼尸，让大姑娘小媳妇发出阵阵惊呼声。
常氏扶着林大河快步走出院门，身后还跟着张雪柔，三人看着门口的狼目瞪口呆。
小满则是躲在门后，神色有些惧怕。
常氏惊疑：“二郎，这……这三头狼，都是你打的？”
林夜点点头：“遇到了五头，可惜跑了两头。”
林大河颤抖着手，翻了翻狼尸。
“一箭毙命，好本事！”
村里人更加震惊，看向林夜的眼神彻底变了。
“天哪！林二郎，你居然打得过五头狼！”
“还有一头獐子，这得值多少钱？”
“大河，你家可要翻身了！”
林大河神色先是一喜，随后又有些忧虑。
他上前搭把手，将狼尸运回家中，关上院门。
随后他拉着林夜回到堂屋，连忙询问：
“二郎，咱们这很少见狼群下山，你是不是去深山了？”
“狼是追捕獐子来到老猫林的，但……你们等等。”
林夜犹豫片刻，最后到灶膛旁，取出两指粗的烧火铁棍，当着家里人的面，双手用力一掰。
在四人如同见鬼的眼神中，烧火棍被他快速掰弯，不费吹灰之力。
“瞧，这就是我说的，神仙传授的锻体之法，我现在身体比一般人强得多。
而且神仙还教了我趋吉避凶之法，遇到危险远远就避开了。”
话音刚落，林大河突然朝他挥了一拳。
林夜本能举手，很轻易就接住了这一拳，面露不解之色。
林大河却是松开眉头，点点头：
“不错，反应很快，力量也足够，倒是有自保之力。”
常氏白了他一眼：“你干啥，别吓到二郎。”
“所以爹娘，你们放心，我肯定没事，再说我也不会冒然深入的。”
加上他独战五头狼的事迹，家里人对他有神仙传授的事，信了十分，果然没那么担忧。
常氏激动之色溢于言表，更是恨不得立马去道观拜一拜。
林小满听不大懂，但还是欢呼拍着手。
content_en:
;;
Lin Ye was as light as a swallow, running through the mountains and forests.
After a while, they returned to the place where they killed the wolf before.
The deer and wolf corpses were still there, so he bled the wolves and deer and eviscerated them.
Then he found a few suitable branches around, tied them with ropes to make a simple drag, held the loot, and returned the same way.
It was already evening when he returned to Shangbai Village, and the villagers quickly noticed him.
As soon as he dragged the prey to the door of his house, a crowd gathered around him.
Those three ferocious wolf corpses made the eldest girl and the young daughter-in-law scream in surprise.
Mrs. Chang helped Lin Dahe quickly walk out of the courtyard, followed by Zhang Xuerou. The three of them looked at the wolf at the door in stunned silence.
Xiaoman was hiding behind the door, looking a little scared.
Chang was surprised: "Erlang, these... these three wolves were all beaten by you?"
Lin Ye nodded: "I met five of them, but unfortunately two of them ran away."
Lin Dahe turned over the wolf corpse with trembling hands.
"Kill with one arrow, great skill!"
The villagers were even more shocked, and the eyes they looked at Lin Ye completely changed.
"Oh my god! Lin Erlang, you can actually beat five wolves!"
"There is also a deer, how much is it worth?"
"Dahe, your family is about to turn over!"
Lin Dahe looked happy at first, then a little worried.
He stepped forward and held the hand, carried the wolf corpse back home, and closed the courtyard door.
Then he took Lin Ye back to the main room and asked quickly:
"Erlang, we rarely see wolves coming down the mountain. Have you gone to the mountains?"
"The wolf came to the old cat forest in pursuit of the deer, but... you wait."
Lin Ye hesitated for a moment, and finally went to the stove, took out a two-finger-thick iron rod for burning fire, and broke it with both hands in front of the family.
In the eyes of the four people as if they had seen a ghost, he quickly bent the fire stick without any effort.
"Look, this is what I said, the body-building method taught by the gods. My body is now much stronger than that of ordinary people.
Moreover, the gods also taught me how to seek good fortune and avoid misfortune. When encountering danger, I stayed away from it. "
As soon as he finished speaking, Lin Dahe suddenly punched him.
Lin Ye instinctively raised his hand and easily caught the punch, with a look of confusion on his face.
Lin Dahe relaxed his brows and nodded:
"Yes, he reacts quickly and has enough strength. He is capable of protecting himself."
Mrs. Chang rolled her eyes at him: "What are you doing? Don't scare Erlang."
"So, parents, don't worry, I'm definitely fine. Besides, I won't go in there rashly."
Coupled with his story of fighting five wolves alone, his family believed him very much that he had an immortal teaching, so they were not that worried.
Chang's excitement was palpable, and she wanted to go to the Taoist temple to pay homage right away.
Lin Xiaoman didn't understand much, but he still cheered and clapped his hands.
